scope: Human occurrence-equal auxiliary-loss weight selection and unbiased train-only evaluation

data.legacy_fixed_test_role: supplementary exploratory only; prohibited for selection, early stopping, epoch choice, thresholds, or model-version choice

primary_selection_metric: macro mean task AUPRC on inner validation folds

tie_rule.rule: Among candidates whose mean inner-CV AUPRC is within 0.002 of the maximum, select the numerically smallest auxiliary weight.

nested_cross_validation.group_definition: Connected components over pair_id, exact peptide_sequence, peptide sequences with Hamming distance <= 1, and equal non-missing source_molecule_uniprot_id or molecule_parent_uniprot_id.
nested_cross_validation.group_assignment: Deterministic greedy balance of task-by-label cells; components are indivisible.
nested_cross_validation.inner_score_formula: Mean of macro task AUPRC over 3 inner folds x 5 training seeds.
nested_cross_validation.outer_refit: For each outer fold, refit the inner-selected weight and no auxiliary on all four outer-training folds for each seed, then evaluate once on the outer holdout.

final_weight_rule.general_rule: Average each candidate's inner-CV score and rank across the five outer folds; apply the frozen 0.002 smaller-weight tie rule to the overall mean inner-CV AUPRC.
final_weight_rule.special_0.10_vs_0.20_gate: Select 0.20 over 0.10 only if its overall inner-CV AUPRC gain is strictly greater than 0.002 and it is not worse than 0.10 in at least 4 of 5 outer-fold inner-CV summaries; otherwise prefer 0.10 when these are the two leading candidates.

fixed_training.preprocessing: Existing Human occurrence-equal preprocessing; 9-mer peptide encoding; task-specific heads.
fixed_training.pairing: For a given fold and seed, all weights use identical shared-layer initialization, explicit independent torch.Generator state, row order, minibatch order, and dropout training stream. Auxiliary heads are initialized after shared layers and the training stream is reset before optimization.

statistics.paired_unit: outer fold and seed where applicable
statistics.confidence_interval: paired hierarchical bootstrap over outer folds with seeds retained within fold

gradient_mechanism_analysis.schedule: first five paired minibatches of every epoch
